Hi Aditya,

I signed up for the self-serve trial this morning (tenant RB-83X) and my team would love to do a very short technical check before we take a full product demo. We're planning an integration spike and want to confirm a few compatibility points so the demo is productive. Do you have 15 minutes available for a "tech scout" today or tomorrow?

Quick background: BrandCart is an e-commerce personalization startup. We're evaluating hosted + private deployment options because we have PII-forward workloads and a VPC peering requirement. Primary questions we want to cover in 15 minutes:
- Can Redwood run in our GCP us-central1 project or do we need specific networking configs?
- Expected latency for a 13B model with 1–2 concurrent streams
- Any tenant-config items we should pre-provision (API keys, model access)

Timezone: I'm in EST but the team is flexible. I'll include our engineering lead if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
